name: Full natural video playback exceeds seven seconds before the actual ended event advances the carousel
Photographs advance every six seconds and returning to the film restarts it from the beginning
Pausing the video holds its slide; no image timer truncates the film
Navigation pause holds an ended film or a photograph, and Resume continues the sequence
Image clocks stop while the document is hidden or the carousel is outside the viewport
Keyboard interaction stops automatic changes until the visitor explicitly restarts them
English mobile carousel advances after the 480p film and through the photo slides
Reduced motion leaves the poster and automatic navigation off; explicit Start enables the film and sequence
Save-Data prevents unsolicited video loading and automatic navigation; explicit Start selects the small variant
Carousels without a film keep their manual navigation
No JavaScript errors during the full automatic cycle
